challenges.claim: The fifth-month Nebuzaradan scene begins at 52:12 and continues through the Chaldeans' breaking and carrying of temple bronze in 52:17-23 without a new date, speaker, or principal agent. Verse 17 narrows the object from city and population to furnishings, but the repeated plunder actions can function as inventory elaboration within the same historical event.
challenges.proposed_remedy: Place Jer.52.12-Jer.52.16 and Jer.52.17-Jer.52.23 under a mandatory Jer.52.12-Jer.52.23 destruction-and-inventory parent, or merge that parent when the retrieval layer cannot guarantee both children.
